why: A whole 3-seat game under the SHIPPED rules of 12/09/2026 (reference-v16): the commons, plus Dean's plain-action balloons (four balloons in the four core-action colours, each giving ONE bonus action, a flight costing one barn card of any crop, the Aerodrome in every game) and the Village Store live (a mint on every delivery and flight, coins paying builds and Grows). Recorded on the same setup as 3p-commons-pre-balloons-opening.json so the two replay seed for seed. The hand limit of 7 is the simulator's bound and not a rule of the game (C7).
